# Light Wave Creators

> Light Wave Creators Sdn. Bhd. is a Kuala Lumpur-based creative agency with teams in Penang and Johor. It offers video production, photography, TikTok Shop MCN, AI chat agents and HRDF-claimable training, and has worked with 300+ brands.

Tagline: From Click to Conversations — We Make Social Work

## Main pages
- [Homepage](https://lightwavecreators.com/): Services, divisions, portfolio and contact details

## Services
- Video production: IP short video, commercial video, brand films
- Photography: event and product photography
- Social media management and influencer marketing
- TikTok MCN and TikTok Shop
- AI chat agents and AI-driven enquiry conversion
- AR / VR / MR immersive activations
- Training and consultancy (HRDF-claimable)
